scenario.title: The Amber Tap
scenario.premise: Kael runs jobs out of a dockside bar called the Amber Tap, taking whatever the fixer's board turns up and coming home to spend the credits before the next one.

runs.title: The Amber Tap
runs.question: Kael's tab at the Tap is a month past due, and Tomas pours slower for a name that owes the house.
runs.situation: The Amber Tap smells of recycled air and cheap synth-whiskey, its walls papered with job flyers gone soft at the corners. Dessa Korr leans on the bar's far end with a data-slate already scrolling, and Tomas Ruiz keeps pouring without waiting to be asked twice.

payload.source: A dockside bar, a fixer's board, and whatever job pays the rent this week.

board.title: The Debt to Ruiz
board.pitch: Tomas needs a debt collected quiet, no questions — no pay, but he wipes what you owe him.

board.title: The Quiet Contract
board.pitch: Sealed manifest to Deck 3 by dawn, hands off the cargo — double the going rate.

board.title: Deck 9 Crate Run
board.pitch: Crates off Deck 9, no manifest, half up front.

dessa-korr.name: Dessa Korr
dessa-korr.brief: The fixer who works the Amber Tap's board; she knows every crew on dock and what each of them owes.

tomas-ruiz.name: Tomas Ruiz
tomas-ruiz.brief: Runs the bar and half the favours owed on this dock; he pours first and asks after.

sil-marrow.name: Sil Marrow
sil-marrow.brief: A regular who never takes a job off the board, only watches who does and writes something down.

player.name: Kael
player.brief: A scarred relic-hunter who comes wherever something old lies sealed, and does not leave it shut.
